text:
maya: Heads-up — PR #7890 updates rate-cap header examples and adds an SDK quickstart for quota-aware retries. Need a docs review + a small dashboard link fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890  Dashboard panel (old link): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/rate-usage

liam: On it. Quick Q: are we renaming the header from X-Rate-Cap to X-RateLimit-Limit? that sounds breaking for integrations.

maya: Not a breaking rename. PR introduces an alias header so both work, but we should pick a canonical name for the docs. @sanjay had suggested a prefixed header last week.

sanjay: I prefer a namespaced header like X-RW-Rate-Limit to avoid collisions. Also suggest the SDK snippet show parsing with a fallback for older header names. Example pseudo-snippet below — quickly added in the thread for context:

```python
# SDK example: read rate header with fallback
headers = response.headers
rate_limit = headers.get('X-RW-Rate-Limit') or headers.get('X-Rate-Cap') or headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit')
if rate_limit:
    limit_val = int(rate_limit.split('/')[0])
    # ... use for adaptive retries
```

liam: Nice. I'll run that against the python sdk and add a small unit test. Would be good to include the same example in the migration guide (v1.10 -> v1.11) so customers know why both headers appear.

maya: FYI docs-bot link-checker flagged the dashboard link in the PR as 404 earlier.

docs-bot: Automated check: broken link detected -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/rate-usage returned 404. Please update.

maya: Fixed — updated the PR to point at the new panel URL: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/efgh/usage-ratepanels  (commit 4f2b7c). Also added a short paragraph explaining what the panel shows and which metric to look at for burst behavior.

product-ops: Small ask: can we add one sentence clarifying that burst credits are tracked per-customer-id (not per-api-key)? We got a support ticket where this was confusing. Suggested language in PR comment.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll include that in the migration guide and the SDK README (under "handling 429s and burst credits"). I'll also add the unit test that asserts header fallback logic.

maya: Plan: finish docs review today, merge PR after one more eng signoff, ship with release 1.12 and add changelog entry under "Rate limits & Quotas". Thanks all — leaving a follow-up comment with the merge checklist.

sanjay: Sounds good. Ping me for signoff once tests run.

maya: will do — thanks!
